description: Fix pre-existing Windows path bug + build the POST /api/evaluate HTTP server in genomex-final/api/ with auth stub, audit log stub, and endpoint tests. The server uses node:http, calls the SAME engine as the UI, and returns the required response shape with no numeric score. PRIMARY location for server files is genomex-final/api/; tests stay in tests/; a SETUP.md doc also goes in genomex-final/api/.
steps: STEP 1 — Fix Windows path bug in tests/helpers.js. The existing line `export const ROOT = new URL('..', import.meta.url).pathname` produces '/C:/Users/...' on Windows, which path.join corrupts to 'C:\C:\...'. Replace with: `import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; export const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));`. This one-line fix makes all existing tests runnable on Windows. Do NOT change anything else in helpers.js.

STEP 2 — Create genomex-final/api/evaluate.js (response-shape builder). Export buildApiResponse(analysis). Maps engine output to { ruleSetVersion, disclaimer, dataAttributions, findings, missingInformation, evidence, validation, meta, notices }. Import DISCLAIMER and ATTRIBUTION from '../../engine/report.js' (two levels up because the file is at genomex-final/api/evaluate.js). 'findings' = analysis.results. 'missingInformation' = analysis.results.flatMap(r => r.missingInfo). 'evidence' = deduplicated evidence objects from all findings (dedup by evidence id). NO numeric score/confidence/probability field anywhere.

STEP 3 — Create genomex-final/api/auth.js. Export checkAuth(req). Reads 'x-api-key' header vs process.env.GENOMX_API_KEY. Returns { ok: true } if key matches OR if env var is not set (dev mode — log a startup warning). Returns { ok: false, reason: '...' } otherwise. Must contain: '// TODO: Replace with a real authentication mechanism. SECURITY REVIEW REQUIRED before any real patient data is used.' and '// IMPORTANT: Real patient data MUST NOT be used until a full security and ethics review is complete.'

STEP 4 — Create genomex-final/api/audit.js. Export logAudit({ patientId, ruleSetVersion }). Uses node:fs appendFileSync to append a single NDJSON line { ts, patientId, ruleSetVersion } to logs/audit.ndjson (in the PROJECT ROOT — two levels up from genomex-final/api/). Use mkdirSync({recursive:true}) to create logs/ if absent. Wrap in try/catch. Project root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url)) from within genomex-final/api/. Comment: '// PHI NOTICE: Only pseudonym/ID and metadata are written here. Clinical findings, genotype data and all patient inputs are NEVER logged.'

STEP 5 — Create genomex-final/api/index.js (main HTTP server). Uses node:http. Imports: loadDatasetFromFs, evaluatePatientAsync from '../../engine/index.js'; buildApiResponse from './evaluate.js'; checkAuth from './auth.js'; logAudit from './audit.js'; fileURLToPath from 'node:url'. Exports makeHandler(ds) which returns an async request handler. Handler flow for POST /api/evaluate: checkAuth → 401; parse body → 400; evaluatePatientAsync(raw, ds) → if analysis.validation.errors.length > 0 return 422 with { error: 'Validation failed', details: analysis.validation.errors }; buildApiResponse → logAudit → 200 JSON. Other routes → 404. Sets Content-Type: application/json. Entry-point guard: `if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` starts server on process.env.PORT || 3001, loads dataset with loadDatasetFromFs(fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url))) (two levels up to project root), logs ruleSetVersion, warns if GENOMX_API_KEY not set.

STEP 6 — Create tests/server.test.js. Uses node:test and node:assert/strict. Helper startServer(): imports makeHandler from '../genomex-final/api/index.js'; reuses ds from './helpers.js'; creates a node:http server, listens on port 0, returns { url, close }. Helper postEvaluate(url, body): node:http.request POST, returns { status, json }. Tests: (a) valid minimal patient (use BASE from reference_cases.js) → 200 + required fields present + no numeric score key in response; (b) { age: -1 } → 422; (c) {} → 200 (engine handles gracefully); (d) unknown route → 404; (e) malformed JSON → 400; (f) response.disclaimer === DISCLAIMER from '../../engine/report.js'. Each test creates its own server instance and calls close() after.

STEP 7 — Create genomex-final/api/SETUP.md. Write a brief setup and usage document covering: (1) how to start the server: `node genomex-final/api/index.js`; (2) the POST /api/evaluate endpoint: method, headers, body shape, response shape; (3) authentication: set GENOMX_API_KEY env var; (4) audit log location: logs/audit.ndjson; (5) security warning: 'Real patient data MUST NOT be used until a full security and ethics review is complete'; (6) data attributions: ClinPGx CC BY-SA 4.0, SIDER, TG-GATEs; (7) disclaimer. Keep it concise (under 80 lines).
acceptance_criteria: Running `node --test "tests/*.test.js"` from the project root passes ALL tests (pre-existing engine, data, ui, and new server tests).
Running `node genomex-final/api/index.js` starts a server on port 3001 without error, logs the ruleSetVersion.

POST http://localhost:3001/api/evaluate with body {"age":40,"allergyHistoryStatus":"none_known","egfrValue":"90","egfrDate":"2026-09-01"} returns HTTP 200 with: ruleSetVersion (non-empty string), disclaimer (contains 'EDUCATIONAL PROTOTYPE' or similar), dataAttributions (contains 'ClinPGx'), findings (array), missingInformation (array), evidence (array).
The response contains NO field named score, confidence, riskscore, overall_score, or probability at any nesting level.
POST with {"age":-1} returns HTTP 422 with details array.
genomex-final/api/auth.js contains 'SECURITY REVIEW REQUIRED' and 'Real patient data MUST NOT be used' comments.
genomex-final/api/audit.js contains PHI NOTICE comment and writes only {ts, patientId, ruleSetVersion} — no clinical data.
genomex-final/api/SETUP.md exists with setup instructions and security warning.
All server files live in genomex-final/api/ with imports using '../../engine/...' relative paths.
